scope: Directions 1, 3 and 5 first-round controlled study; no combined CPU candidate
workloads: Frozen Embench19 plus balanced FP32 eight
direction_1: Existing A same-flow physical qualification against completed baseline/B
direction_3: Read-only FP EX0 / FU-ready / completion contention observations plus observer invariance and actual controls
direction_5: Native path decomposition and measured FP operation/latency/throughput evidence; pipeline proposal only if supported
performance_claim_policy: Do not turn overlapping waits into saved cycles or partial suites into acceptance scores
next_architecture_policy: Present measured evidence and concrete candidate choices for joint review; preserve independent experiments
